text:
elaine: quick follow-up from last night's DB flapping postmortem. we agreed to tune alerts to reduce noise + dedupe paging. need concrete owners and timelines.

samir: i'll take ownership of threshold tuning for "db-replica-lag". plan: reduce sensitivity, add 3min suppression window. target EOD Fri.

morgan: i'll handle dedupe rules and pager-route refinement. will prototype rule using label set on replicas. target Mon EOD.

ryan: i'll own paging policy changes (quiet-hours, escalation). propose: don't page for P2 alerts until 2 repeated signals in 10m. onboarding doc + playbook update by next Wed.

leah: i'll run a sweep of recurring incidents to build a suppression list. will produce a CSV of noisy rules and suggested owners by Tue.

ops-bot: Incident 22341 postmortem link: https://pm.redwood/22341

elaine: action items recap:
- samir: threshold tuning (db-replica-lag) — due Fri EOD
- morgan: dedupe rules & routing — due Mon EOD
- ryan: paging policy + playbook — due Wed next week
- leah: recurring incident sweep CSV — due Tue

morgan: draft of dedupe rule:
```yaml
if alert.labels.instance and alert.duplicates > 1:
  suppress_for: 15m
  route_to: oncall-primary
```

samir: suggested threshold change:
`replica_lag_seconds > 120 for 3m` -> `replica_lag_seconds > 180 for 5m`

elaine: please add PRs to the alerts repo and ping #eng-oncall when ready. we'll do a quick runway review Thu 10:30am PT.

ryan: added calendar invite: https://cal.redwood/alerts-runway Thu 10:30am

leah: FYI, I'll include a column for 'should_suppress' in the CSV and initial confidence score.

morgan: quick question: do we want global dedupe across regions or per-region? leaning per-region for now.

elaine: per-region for now, but include a note in the PR to consider global dedupe later.

samir: ok. I'll open the thresholds PR today and tag @morgan @ryan for review.

elaine: thanks all. Can we check in next Wed standup for status? If anything slips, update the thread.

ryan: ack :thumbsup:

morgan: ack

samir: ack

leah: ack
